subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should this interactive-parity rollout land as one broad PR with update_plan default-on and goalDriver config, or should maintainers require staged question, plan, and goal PRs after conflict resolution and live channel proof?
rationale: The remaining choice changes default tool exposure, adds unattended goal behavior, and spans core, UI, protocol, SDK, and Slack/Telegram delivery, so automation cannot infer the intended release shape.

options.title: Fix, prove, and stage
options.body: Require conflict resolution, redacted live Slack/Telegram proof, and staged question/plan/goal PRs unless maintainers explicitly approve the bundle.

options.title: Land the bundle after proof
options.body: Accept one broad rollout after fresh CI, live channel proof, and explicit sign-off on update_plan default-on plus goalDriver.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the roadmap hub to continue through narrower replacement PRs.

recommendation.title: Fix, prove, and stage
recommendation.body: Require conflict resolution, redacted live Slack/Telegram proof, and staged question/plan/goal PRs unless maintainers explicitly approve the bundle.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history signal for the execution-contract and update_plan policy decision this PR changes.
